title: Joy Squad
label: vocals
labelReason: Artist explicitly identifies vocal processing in this exact track, even though it functions as percussion.

evidence.text: In his track-by-track interview for Agor, Koreless explains in the Frozen section that Frozen and Joy Squad turn vocals into short percussive sounds.

title: Primes
label: instrumental
labelReason: Artist describes the entire track as made only of sine waves; stronger than absent vocal credits. This remains a source-based label, not an audio audit.

evidence.text: Discussing Primes in his Agor track-by-track interview, Koreless says the track is made only of sine waves.

title: Haul (feat. Mohna)

label: vocals
labelReason: Artist album description explicitly maps Mohna vocals to Haul.

title: Lid
label: vocals
labelReason: Artist release description explicitly identifies Löffler singing on Lid; no featured vocalist in title.

evidence.text: The artist description of Mare says Löffler himself sings on Lid, Pacific and Nil; the tracklist lists Lid at 5:10.

title: Found
label: vocals
labelReason: Artist track description explicitly identifies an Alan Watts vocal sample. This supports voice presence; the speaker attribution indicates speech.

evidence.text: Rosehip describes Found as the first single from the 2023 Odyssey EP and identifies a vocal sample from philosopher Alan Watts in its arrangement.

title: Slow It Down
version: Kinetic EP track; artist page dates track February 2, 2020; artist identity: https://blackdown.bandcamp.com
label: vocals
labelReason: Artist track page explicitly credits vocal samples. Artist identity must use this Bandcamp account, not another artist with the same name.

evidence.text: The artist page for Slow It Down says its beat was inspired by Missy Elliot, describes a Loopcloud vocal sample, and credits Loopcloud for vocal samples.

title: Mania (Instrumental Version)
label: instrumental
labelReason: Artist track description explicitly says this is the full track without vocals. The page also contains lyrics, which should not override this exact-version description.

evidence.text: The artist describes Mania (Instrumental Version) as the full recording with vocals removed. Its page also includes a lyrics section and credits drums, guitars and bass to Blake Robinson.

title: Better - (Instrumental Version)
label: instrumental
labelReason: Exact track is explicitly marked instrumental on a collection the artist describes as versions without vocal lines. No separate audio audit.

evidence.text: Beckett lists Better - (Instrumental Version), duration 4:05, on Vocal Free. The artist describes this collection as versions exposing the arrangements without their vocal lines.

title: Endless Falls
version: Endless Falls title track, 2010, 7:55; not The Making of Grief Point
label: unknown
labelReason: Artist interview places Dan Bejar on a different track. It does not explicitly establish absence of all voices or samples in this title track; unscorable for binary accuracy.

evidence.text: Scott Morgan discusses the album Endless Falls and identifies Dan Bejar as the voice on its final track, The Making of Grief Point.

title: Nespole
label: unknown
labelReason: Label credits singers at album level without mapping them to Nespole. Neither vocal presence nor absence established for this exact track; unscorable for binary accuracy.

evidence.text: Luaka Bop lists Nespole on Elaenia and credits album vocals to Rahel Debebe-Dessalegne, Layla Rutherford and Sam Shepherd. The one-sheet does not assign those vocal credits by track.
